answer: Proof-of-reserves attestation acts as a bridge: each agent's identity keys map to on-chain balances reconciled against cold-wallet holdings, so a sybil cluster must fund every fake identity with real capital. A sonnet of signed ledger snapshots then anchors each key to historical inflow trails, forcing attackers to sustain costly, traceable deposits per puppet. The limit is the tide of self-transfers between colluding wallets, which inflates apparent reserves without new capital.
